goldPrices.dateInvalid: Type a day as dd/MM/yyyy, such as 05/10/2026.
goldPrices.priceInvalid: Type a price above zero, with two decimals at most, such as 5125.50.
goldPrices.fixedNote: A saved price set is not changed or deleted: a new set replaces it.
goldPrices.emptyBody: Add the first prices from “Add prices”, then save them to see them here.
goldPrices.latestOpens: Latest records: open the Gold price history

branches.title: Branches
branches.deleteBody: It will no longer appear in lists or as a choice. Old documents and reports do not change. This cannot be undone.
branches.emptyBody: Add the first branch from “Add branch”, then save it to see it here.
branches.nameTaken: Another branch already has this name.
branches.latestOpens: Latest records: open the Branch list
branches.findHint: Type a branch code or part of its name, then choose the branch to open it.
branches.findMore: {count, plural, one {# more branch} other {# more branches}}: type more to narrow the list.
branches.adminHint: One Admin runs one branch. Admins are added on Admin accounts.
branches.adminNone: No Admin found. Add one on Admin accounts first.
branches.adminMore: {count, plural, one {# more Admin} other {# more Admins}}: type more to narrow the list.
branches.adminTaken: This Admin already runs another branch. Choose another.
branches.twoTreasuries: Saving opens the branch with its two treasuries: an EGP treasury and a Gold treasury.

kindChoice.label: Type
kindChoice.required: Choose the type: EGP or Gold.

treasury-reports.daysInvalid: Type a whole number of days, such as 3.

treasury-transfers.title: Treasury transfers
treasury-transfers.noTreasuries: You may not do treasury transactions. An Admin turns this on in your user record.
treasury-transfers.pieceCodePlaceholder: Scan or type a code, then Enter
treasury-transfers.pieceCodeHint: A hand scanner adds the piece on Enter. Nothing is held until you press Send.
treasury-transfers.notOurCode: This is not one of our piece codes
treasury-transfers.switchKeyboard: Switch the keyboard to English and scan again.
treasury-transfers.tooManyPieces: At most {max} pieces in one transfer
treasury-transfers.goldInvalid: Choose a karat and type a weight above zero, three decimals at most.
treasury-transfers.karatAdded: This karat is already added: remove it first.
treasury-transfers.amountInvalid: Type an amount with two decimals at most, such as 5000.00.
treasury-transfers.pickBoth: Choose the sending and the receiving treasury.
treasury-transfers.emptyTransfer: Add a piece, bulk gold or an amount.
treasury-transfers.cannotAccept: You cannot accept this transfer: you sent it, or you may not use the receiving treasury.
treasury-transfers.noTargets: No other branch has a treasury of this kind yet.

nav.jobsHome: What do you want to do?
nav.jobsQuestions: What do you want to know?

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty: Notifications will appear here: what needs your attention, in one place. We are building it now.

whatsNew.title: What's new
whatsNew.sub: Every version in plain words, where to see it in the system, and one tap to open the screen. For the Admin and the Super admin only.

app.searchPlaceholder: Search pages, jobs, questions, an invoice number or a piece code…
app.pinHint: Press the pin next to any page to pin it here.
app.noAccess: You do not have access to this page
app.mustChange: You must change your password first
app.sessionEnded: Your session ended. Sign in again.

home.priceNote: This is the latest saved price; it is used everywhere until a new one is saved.
home.pinsEmpty: Press the pin next to any page in the menu and it shows here.

signIn.cookie: Sign-in was accepted but the browser did not keep the session. Try again.

test-printer.title: Test printer
test-printer.sub: Print test labels on your label printer. Change the size, direction and rotation until the printout comes out right.
test-printer.textPh: Any text to print on the label
test-printer.importHint: Or import an Excel file: column A is the free text, column B is the QR code content, columns C, D, E... are extra lines.
test-printer.loaded: {count} labels loaded from {name}. The fields above are not used.
test-printer.readFail: Could not read {name}. Use an Excel .xlsx file.
test-printer.nothing: Type some text or a QR code to print.
test-printer.logoHint: PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG, up to 3 MB. It stays in this browser; nothing is uploaded.
test-printer.logoBadType: This file is not allowed. Choose a PNG, JPG, WebP or SVG image.
test-printer.logoTooBig: This file is bigger than 3 MB. Choose a smaller image.
test-printer.logoReadFail: Could not read this image. Try another file.
test-printer.dragHint: Drag a part to move it; it snaps into place. Tap a part to edit it, then drag its corner to resize.
test-printer.logoMm: Logo size (mm, the square it fits in)
test-printer.logoPct: Logo size (% of the QR width)
test-printer.logoLevelH: While the logo is inside the QR, the QR error level is forced to H so the code can still be read.
test-printer.logoTooBig30: Above 30% the code may stop scanning. Test it with a scanner.
test-printer.resetAllText: The settings, texts, extra lines, logo and imported Excel labels go back to the start, and what is saved in this browser is cleared.
test-printer.saveFail: Could not save in this browser
test-printer.batchNotSaved: The imported Excel labels are too big to save in this browser. They stay until you reload the page.
test-printer.labelFactoryText: The saved look is removed for the whole ERP. Labels print as they did before. This page keeps what you have now.
test-printer.labelNothing: Nothing saved yet: labels print as before
test-printer.labelSavedToast: Saved. Every QR label in the ERP now prints with these settings.
test-printer.labelFactoryToast: Back to factory. Labels print as before.
test-printer.labelLoadFail: Could not read what is saved for the ERP
test-printer.labelErrOffline: Could not reach the server. Check the connection and try again.
test-printer.labelErrForbidden: Only an Admin can change this.
test-printer.labelErrTooBig: The settings are too big to save. Use a smaller logo.
test-printer.labelNewer: {name} saved a newer look on {when}. This page still has your unsaved changes.
test-printer.labelNewerAnon: A newer look was saved on {when}. This page still has your unsaved changes.
test-printer.capHint: The words are the QR content. A long text shrinks to the QR width.
